compute_feature_stats_for_dataset: compute feature statistics for a dataset using a cached feature detector and DataLoader
compute_feature_stats_for_generator: compute feature statistics for a generator by sampling latent vectors and running the detector
FeatureStats_append: append numpy feature arrays to a FeatureStats object for incremental mean and covariance tracking
FeatureStats_get_mean_cov: get the computed mean and covariance from a FeatureStats object after appending features
get_feature_detector: load and cache a TorchScript feature detector model from a URL for multi-GPU evaluation
